title: Before Agents Decide: Epistemic Action in LLM-Based Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.00511v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Before a difficult decision, people often act simply to understand the situation better. We turn an object to see another side, place alternatives next to each other, or change one condition and observe what happens. These actions may not complete the task, but they improve the evidence needed for the next choice. LLM-based agents can search and explore, yet agent design gives less attention to an earlier question: is the available evidence ready for the decision? Sometimes necessary evidence is missing. In other cases, the evidence is present but its form hides what matters, or the comparison needed to judge it does not yet exist. Cognitive science calls actions that improve the basis for a later choice epistemic actions. We bring this idea to LLM-based agents and distinguish three modes: acquiring missing evidence, transforming available evidence, and probing a system to create a revealing response. translated_title: 在智能体决策之前：基于大语言模型系统中的认知行动
translated_abstract: 在做出困难决策之前，人们常常仅仅为了更好地理解情况而行动。我们翻转物体以看到另一面，将备选方案并排放置在一起，或者改变一个条件并观察会发生什么。这些行动可能无法完成任务，但它们改善了下一个选择所需的证据基础。基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体能够进行搜索和探索，然而智能体设计对更早的一个问题关注较少：可用的证据是否已为决策做好准备？有时必要的证据是缺失的；在另一些情况下，证据虽然存在，但其形式掩盖了重要的内容，或者判断它所需的比较尚不存在。认知科学将那些能够改善后续选择基础的行动称为“认知行动”。我们将这一概念引入基于LLM的智能体，并区分出三种模式：获取缺失的证据、转换可用的证据，以及探测系统以引发具有揭示性的响应。我们使用“认知脚手架”这一术语（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将认知科学中的“认知行动”概念引入基于大语言模型的智能体设计，区分了获取缺失证据、转换现有证据和探测系统三种模式，主张智能体在做出决策之前应首先改善其证据基础。
en_tdlr: This paper brings the cognitive science concept of "epistemic actions" into LLM-based agent design, distinguishing three modes—acquiring missing evidence, transforming available evidence, and probing systems for revealing responses—and argues that agents should improve their evidence base before making decisions.
